sum: Semantic code search served over MCP: the codebase goes into a vector index once, and the agent retrieves the relevant parts instead of being handed directories.

evidence.co.standards: cites standards_conformance.evidence: conforms to 1 of the 5 neutral interface standards (AGENTS.md)
evidence.se.residency: cites data_residency: self-hostable, the state leaves the machine but the operator can own the service; keys are the operator's own (byok)
evidence.se.threats: cites th and ctrl: T2/T6 introduced, controls egress none, log part
evidence.fx.exit: artifact.format store: a store the tool owns; what survives removal depends on an export path
evidence.sf.reach: restates exec, ctrl and data_residency: the entry does not execute code itself, but self-hostable means its state reaches a service, and no egress control is recorded
evidence.co.coexist: states the hosts it sits beside: Claude Code, OpenAI Codex, Codex CLI, Gemini CLI, Cursor, Windsurf, Cline, Roo Code, JetBrains (README.md)
evidence.ic.surface: Surface: cli (README.md (npx @zilliz/claude-context-mcp, started as an MCP server))
evidence.ic.help: a command-line parser that prints its own usage: packages/chrome-extension/src/options.ts (click)
evidence.fx.install: an install that does not change the machine globally: README.md (npx @)
evidence.fx.byo: the provider is the operator's choice: OPENAI, OLLAMA, BASEURL, OPENROUTER (README.md)
evidence.sf.stop: it can be stopped, but what the working tree looks like afterwards is not described: packages/mcp/src/index.ts (graceful shutdown)

pre: a vector database to index into
an embedding provider, which is a cost and a data-egress decision
anti: repositories small enough to read whole
work that must not send source to an embedding service
gnote: Indexing a codebase means sending it to an embedding provider, which is the residency question this axis exists to record. A merkle tree keeps the index in sync, so the cost is paid once rather than per request.

ja.sum: MCP越しに提供する意味検索。コードベースを一度ベクトル索引に入れ、ディレクトリを丸ごと渡す代わりに関係する箇所だけをエージェントが引く。
ja.art: コードベースのベクトル索引（永続）
pre: 索引先のベクトルデータベース
埋め込みプロバイダ。費用でもありデータ持ち出しの判断でもある
anti: 丸ごと読める規模のリポジトリ
ソースを埋め込みサービスへ送れない業務
ja.gnote: コードベースの索引化とは埋め込みプロバイダへ送ることであり、データ所在の軸が存在する理由そのものである。マークルツリーで索引を同期するため、費用は毎回ではなく一度で済む。
